title: Extract VOIs
description: Crops one VOI (image + mask) per organ side from the selected segmentation set and measures the lesions in each crop. Sides come from patient coordinates, so prone and feet-first scans are handled. Writes NIfTI in RAS, a voi_catalog.jsonl and the training files (lesion catalog, sampling profile, dataset fingerprint) into the derived root, and a lesions table for the dashboard.

region.x-help: Kidney and lung give one VOI per side; the others one VOI around the organ

labels.x-help: Label names that make up the VOI; empty uses the region's labels

margin_mm.x-help: Added around the labels on every side; empty uses the region's margin

min_size_mm.x-help: Minimum VOI size (x, y, z) in mm; empty uses the region's size

resample_mm.x-help: Isotropic voxel size of the output; 0 keeps the scan's voxels

skip_existing.x-help: Leave out scans that already have VOIs in the project; off extracts them again into this run's folder

keep_labels.x-help: Keep every label in the mask crop; off writes a binary mask of the VOI labels

measure_lesions.x-help: Measure every lesion (a connected part of the lesion labels) in the crop as written

lesion_labels.x-help: Label names that make up lesions; empty uses the region's protected labels (kidney: tumor)

organ_labels.x-help: Label names a lesion's contact is measured against; empty uses the region's organ labels

min_lesion_voxels.x-help: Smaller connected parts are left out and counted in the catalog

bin_percentiles.x-help: Lesion volume percentiles that cut the size bins of the sampling profile

balancing_alpha.x-help: 0 samples each size bin as often as it occurs; 1 samples every bin equally

budget_by_bin.x-help: Patches per lesion for each size bin, smallest first; empty grows with the bin

role_priors_by_bin.x-help: Center, border and context weights per size bin, smallest first; empty shifts from center to context as bins grow

hu_window.x-help: HU window the loader rescales to -1…1 (low, high)

patch_size_candidates.x-help: Patch sizes (x, y, z voxels) to check against the lesion boxes

overrides.x-help: Reviewer decisions from the VOI view: swap sides or exclude VOIs per item
